name.en-US: On the State of the Inner Man
name.pt-BR: Sobre o estado do homem interior

description.en-US: Richard’s treatise on the state of the inner man after the Fall: free will, counsel, the weakness of fleshly desire and the restoration by grace. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 196, 1855), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: O tratado de Ricardo sobre o estado do homem interior depois da queda.

sources.edition: Migne, Patrologia Latina 196 (Paris 1855); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text RiSVi.DeStInH, from the machine-corrected OCR of the Open Greek and Latin project.
sources.description: The complete PL text with its chapter divisions. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and the PL tables of chapters (which repeat the chapter headings) are not imported. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Migne’s Patrologia Latina (1854–1855) prints the medieval text; public domain everywhere.
